name: Quick Suit [Psionic]
body:
You have learned to quickly form your astral suit.

Prerequisite: Astral suit class feature, reconfigure class feature.

Benefit: You can form your astral suit as a free action once per turn.

Normal: Forming an astral suit takes a swift action for astral skin, a standard action for astral armor, and a full-round action for astral juggernaut.
